columns.name: Facility Name
columns.description: Legal name of the licensed Hospice Program as recorded by IDPH. May include a "DBA" (doing business as) trade name. Multi-location hospices appear once per licensed parent office; satellite or "multiple hospice locations" sharing administration with the parent are not separately listed.

columns.name: Address
columns.description: Street address of the program's licensed parent office. Suite or building numbers are included where applicable.

columns.name: City
columns.description: Municipality of the program's licensed parent office.

columns.name: County
columns.description: Illinois county of the program's licensed parent office. The program's approved geographic service area typically extends well beyond this county; consult IDPH for full service area details.

columns.name: Zip
columns.description: Five-digit U.S. Postal Service ZIP code of the program's licensed parent office.

columns.name: Contact Name
columns.description: Primary administrative contact at the program, designated for IDPH correspondence. Typically the program administrator or hospice director.

columns.name: Phone
columns.description: Main published telephone number for the program, including area code. Format: (XXX) XXX-XXXX.

columns.name: License Number
columns.description: License number issued by the Illinois Department of Public Health authorizing operation as a Hospice Program under 210 ILCS 60 and 77 Ill. Adm. Code 280. This is the state license number only; CMS hospice certification numbers (CCN) are issued separately and are not included in this dataset.

columns.name: Exp. Date
columns.description: Date on which the program's current IDPH license expires. Programs must submit a renewal application prior to this date to maintain authority to operate. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
